title: Snakes and Ladders
constraints: Each board[i][j] is -1 or a destination label from 1 to n^2
Squares 1 and n^2 contain no snake or ladder
inputFormat: Implement snakesAndLadders(board). Inputs below show JavaScript function arguments; there is no stdin parsing.
outputFormat: Return the minimum number of die rolls needed to reach square n^2, or -1 if it is unreachable.

visuals.title: Square labels on a 3 × 3 board
visuals.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 360 230" role="img" aria-label="Three by three board numbered 7 8 9 on the top row, 6 5 4 in the middle, and 1 2 3 on the bottom"><g fill="none" stroke="currentColor" opacity=".3"><path d="M90 10H270V190H90Z M150 10V190 M210 10V190 M90 70H270 M90 130H270"/></g><g fill="currentColor" text-anchor="middle" font-family="system-ui,sans-serif" font-size="20"><text x="120" y="47">7</text><text x="180" y="47">8</text><text x="240" y="47">9</text><text x="120" y="107">6</text><text x="180" y="107">5</text><text x="240" y="107">4</text><text x="120" y="167">1</text><text x="180" y="167">2</text><text x="240" y="167">3</text><text x="180" y="218" font-size="13">Start at 1 · Finish at 9</text></g></svg>
visuals.caption: These are square labels, not cell values. The top array row contains squares 7, 8, and 9; a cell value gives a jump destination or -1.
